## What this changes

<!-- What you observed, not only what you edited. If it fixes something, say what
     failed first — CONTRIBUTING.md's first rule is reproduce before fixing. -->

## Evidence

<!-- How do you know it works? A failing test that now passes, a command and its
     output, a cluster you can point at. -->

- [ ] I reproduced the problem before fixing it
- [ ] I mutation-checked any behavioural claim — broke the thing under test and
      watched the test fail. (A mutation that does not compile is INVALID, not
      survived.)
- [ ] Where I claim a rule refused something, I checked it was *that* rule

## Designs

<!-- If this contradicts a design, the design is amended in this PR. Amendments
     are numbered and kept; evidence against the change is addressed in the text,
     never deleted. If it claims something about another design, quote that
     design and cite the line. -->

- [ ] No design contradicted, or the design is amended here

## Still unproven
